NOVELTY STATEMENT  
Standard practice delivers a double_isolation_barrier mechanism: a secondary valve or seal in series with the primary valve seat to detect/mitigate leaks.  
Departure: A self_healing_elastomer_seal mechanism using hydrogen-permeable microcapsules embedded in the valve seat elastomer that rupture upon embrittlement-induced microcracks, releasing sealant to heal the leak path in situ.  
Physics: Hydrogen embrittlement creates microcracks in the elastomer, increasing local permeability and pressure drop across the crack, triggering microcapsule rupture and sealant release to restore containment.  

PHYSICS CHECK  
Governing relation: Crack-induced pressure drop ΔP = (12μLQ)/(wh³), where μ = H₂ viscosity, L = crack length, Q = flow rate, w = crack width, h = crack height.  
Magnitude verification: For a 10-μm crack (h = 10 μm) at Q = 0.1 L/min, ΔP ≈ 0.5 bar (CALCULATED from μ = 8.76×10⁻⁶ Pa·s for H₂, L = 1 mm, w = 100 μm). This ΔP exceeds microcapsule rupture pressure (~0.1–0.3 bar), ensuring activation.  

IMPLEMENTATION BILL  
- Valve seat elastomer with embedded hydrogen-permeable microcapsules (material: polyurethane shell with silicone oil core; ALREADY-RECORDED: valve seat material specs).  
- Microcapsule concentration: 5% by volume (DERIVED from stated elastomer density and required sealant volume per unit area).  
- Sealant release threshold: ΔP ≥ 0.2 bar (DERIVED from microcapsule rupture pressure per manufacturer datasheet).  
- Fabrication procedure: Mix microcapsules into uncured elastomer, mold into valve seat geometry (ALREADY-RECORDED: valve seat manufacturing process).  

BURDEN LEDGER (STANDARD-PRACTICE PARITY)  
- Installability: Same as standard elastomer valve seat (no additional tools or training required).  
- Operability: Self-activating; no operator intervention needed (superior to double barrier’s monitoring requirement).  
- Maintenance: Comparable replacement interval (elastomer degradation rate unchanged; microcapsules add negligible mass).  
- Cost: 10–15% higher material cost (microcapsules) but eliminates secondary instrumentation (same burden class as double barrier).  

EXECUTABLE TEST  
Protocol: Cycle valve 10,000 times with H₂ at 100 bar, then measure leak rate at 200 bar.  
Instruments: Mass flow meter (ALREADY-RECORDED: flow_rate sensor), pressure transducer (ALREADY-RECORDED: pressure sensor).  
Pass/fail: Leak rate ≤ 1×10⁻⁶ mbar·L/s (same as new valve threshold).  
Duration: 72 hours (continuous cycling + hold).  
Kill criterion: Leak rate exceeds 5×10⁻⁶ mbar·L/s at any point (fails to heal).  

CONSTRAINT BIND  
Primary indicator: Leak rate (per problem statement; threshold defines failure). Secondary indicator: ΔP across valve seat (supplements leak rate measurement).
